pillars.note: No direct fire-safety pillar. The final report says that one of the six ACME experiments was focused on spacecraft fire safety and that it was BRE, not CFI-G (the sentence wraps over the two quoted lines, p. 68). CFI-G studies cool diffusion flames of gases. It is still relevant to habitat fire safety through its high-O2 microgravity data: ambient O2 up to 39.97 percent in the experimental table (for example the Normal Flames row 140, XO2 before test 0.3997); the 85 percent values are the burner stream of inverse flames (o2_basis oxidizer_stream), not the chamber atmosphere. That is a data property, not a pillar. Pillar list left empty on purpose.
